name: electron_ramsey_experiment_focused_grid_smoke
description: Fast smoke test of the electron-only Ramsey OU grid focused on experimentally observed or experimentally inferred NV bath-correlation regimes.

diagonal.label: ZZZ
diagonal.note: Final direct 11-component Fourier ZZZ pulse. Change only if a later independently verified direct checkpoint replaces it.

t2_star_regimes.description: Conservative Ramsey scale used in published NV-center OU magnetic-noise modeling.
Register-representative point close to the measured electron T2*=4.9(2) us.
Conservative enriched-material benchmark; Ramsey times above 200 us have been reported in highly 12C-enriched diamond.

tau_c_regimes.description: Representative fast-bath point within correlation times inferred by fitting NV-ensemble Hahn-echo data across spin concentrations; not a direct measurement for this register.
Representative gate-scale point within experimentally inferred NV-ensemble correlation-time ranges; not a direct measurement for this register.
Representative intermediate point within experimentally inferred NV-ensemble correlation-time ranges; not a direct measurement for this register.
Directly measured single-NV P1-bath autocorrelation regime: 30 +/- 8 us for the complete environment and 24 +/- 8 us for a resolved bath group.
